c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Set the cycle flavor (shotgun | compare | refine) in the top-level flavor field; the human picks, you may recommend. Shotgun: pure divergence, a deliberately challenging idea count (default ~20, human-set) as cheap one-liners, wild entries sanctioned, light excursions only. Compare: 2-5 candidates developed seriously with trade-offs, recommendation-led, excursions per candidate where earned. Refine: harden one direction, chase open threads, test load-bearing assumptions, tighten interfaces in deep-module terms. Seed the FIRST cycle from templates/EXPLORER_STARTING_QUESTIONS.template.md (the itch; for whom; what does done feel like; what already exists; what would make this pointless); later cycles seed from the ideas board's open threads. Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: Flavor: shotgun (human-directed variant) — cycle 1 is divergence sourced from the review corpus rather than invented one-liners: four human-requested research excursions (epic-298, explore-grander-scale, episodes, issues), consolidation clusters their findings into candidate directions. Human framed the cycle himself in the 2026-08-03 directive; flavor-fit misfit will be reported at closeout.

q1.title: What is the point of this exploration?
q1.imperative: Crystallize the itch, for whom, what done feels like, and the kill condition from the human's directive (2026-08-03). Record as finding.
q1.finding: The point: post-phase-1 (epic #298 + #299-#310) the backlog holds many issues/episodes of unclear standing. Itch: too many in-the-weeds issues; unclear which block the target architecture. For: Tommy + the fleet working this repo. Done feels like: short honest backlog, every survivor tied to target architecture or a real defect, plus a confirmed next-step design toward the grander-scale vision. Kill condition: if open work is already coherent and next step already cut, route to Admiral instead.

consolidation.summary: Cycle 1 (evidence-gathering) complete: 4/4 excursions answered with cited artifacts under evidence/. Consolidated picture: phase 1 delivered its two headline results but left three loop-ends open (no consolidation ever ran; audit finding 2 unowned; B1 loop open at the write end); the target architecture's federation door is now formally unlocked (#307 PASS met the stated precondition) and the spec routes that revisit to a new exploration; the 127-issue backlog consolidates into 13 clusters with ~10 immediate closures/merges and one upstream question (K13: does the corpus reach any run at all — #331). Candidate directions and open threads folded into IDEAS_BOARD.md; no cull yet; convergence is Tommy's call.
